comment: The VDI agent in Dustline (2026-10-15, Phase 7, docs/EXCAVATIONS.md). Lore provisional: Vantage Deep Industries, pre-collapse deep-excavation giant; its machines still take instructions nobody remembers installing.

npc.dustline_vdi_agent.name: VDI FIELD UNIT  ·  EXPEDITION SERVICE
lines: Vantage Deep Industries. We go where the world ends. State your business.
One Expedition Service, one drillship, one hole in the ground with your name on it. Ten thousand Metal. Delivery is immediate.
Our ships drill. You walk. Batteries and fuel keep the bore going; every floor down costs more than the last.
Settlements, roads and other people's sites are excluded. Open ground only. The ship is large; stand back when it lands.
This unit has been operating for an unrecorded number of years. Instructions continue to arrive. They are followed.
The 261.6.66 network does not reach our ships. VDI has its own lines. Nobody answers on them.
